//: Copy to appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored) and fill in. Never commit the real file.

Notifications.//: Both channels are off until Enabled is true. SMS costs money per message: it is capped by DailyLimit and no notification type sends it by default.

Scanner.//: Uploaded files are checked for malware before they are stored. Off on a developer machine (Development sets Required=false); to try it: `docker compose up -d clamav` in backend/ — the first start downloads the signature database (a minute or two) — then set Provider to clamav. Anywhere else Required stays true: with no scanner (or clamd down) uploads are refused rather than stored unchecked.

local.//BaseUrl: Ollama compose service: http://educenter-ollama:11434 from the API container, http://localhost:11434 from the host. Native /api/chat is used, so no /v1 suffix.
local.//DisableReasoning: Qwen3 and other hybrid-reasoning models answer directly instead of thinking first — faster, and the answer never ends up in a separate reasoning field.

tts.//Enabled: The examiner's questions are read aloud only when this is on: `docker compose up -d tts` in backend/ (first start downloads the Piper voices), then set Enabled. Off, the page shows the question as text and offers the browser's own voice.
tts.//BaseUrl: openedai-speech on the compose network. A paid provider later needs only its own BaseUrl (https://api.openai.com/v1) and "ApiKey" here — never in a committed file.
